description: ARRAY_UNION_AGG(array) is Snowflake's MULTISET union (live-verified): each element keeps the MAXIMUM multiplicity it has in any single input array, so [2,2,2] unioned with [2,2] is [2,2,2] and a lone [5,5] keeps both fives; a NULL row contributes nothing and an all-NULL group yields the empty array. Element order is not guaranteed by Snowflake, so the Java class compared sorted numeric elements - the converted suite does the same server-side with ARRAY_SORT, reading the result through TO_JSON so the assertion is on the array's JSON text rather than on a transport's own rendering of an ARRAY cell. Converted 1:1 from functions/ArrayUnionAggTest (now retired); its @BeforeEach fixture is inlined per test.

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE arr_t (g INTEGER, a ARRAY)
SELECT g, TO_JSON(ARRAY_SORT(ARRAY_UNION_AGG(a))) FROM arr_t GROUP BY g ORDER BY g
CREATE TABLE arr_n (g INTEGER, a ARRAY)
INSERT INTO arr_n VALUES (7, NULL), (7, NULL)
SELECT TO_JSON(ARRAY_UNION_AGG(a)) FROM arr_n GROUP BY g
